channel.title: Nobel Dahal · Writing
channel.description: Case studies and notes from building business software.

item.title: Why every edit in Kaede leaves a fingerprint
item.description: An air waybill is a contract. Here's how Kaede makes a quiet edit to its history show up, using nothing more exotic than SHA-256.

item.title: Teaching a UI library to speak Nepali
item.description: I translated Syncfusion's Essential JS 2, 64 components and over four thousand strings, into Nepali. These are the choices that made it read like Nepali and not like a dictionary.

item.title: Taking money on a government website
item.description: How Kalimati's traders came to pay their dues from their phones through eSewa and Khalti, and the checks that keep a public payment page honest.

item.title: One developer, one market, no ads
item.description: Building the website and Android app for Kalimati, the market that sets vegetable prices for half of Kathmandu, on my own.

item.title: A date that didn't fit in an integer
item.description: The year 4123 crashed Laravel's date validation on 32-bit PHP. Here's how I found it, and the four-line fix that shipped in Laravel 8.

item.title: Finding the nearest agent among millions
item.description: A US brokerage moved from Zoho to Microsoft Dynamics. The data moved fine; the question it couldn't answer quickly was "who is closest to this lead?"

item.title: The check that only lived in the browser
item.description: How an email field in Everest Forms trusted the browser, how I closed it, and the regression I shipped and fixed along the way.
